payload.name: Allianz Direct España
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment. 

Data required for quotation: To generate an indicative quotation, the Service will request the following information: date of birth, driving license details, vehicle data (registration plate, date of first registration and type of use), postcode, estimated annual mileage and payment frequency preference. The Service does not collect national identification documents or any special categories of personal data.

payload.name: UK Property Valuation

Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

payload.name: H&R Block
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get expert-prepared tax returns and personalized advice at any of our 9,000 offices nationwide. Our appointment-setting app connects you with a local tax professional. Schedule your visit and have your taxes done in as little as one hour. payload.name: TaxHeaven

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TaxHeaven gives self-employed workers, freelancers, sole traders, and landlords instant UK tax answers using HMRC-published rates, right inside ChatGPT.

• Calculate income tax, National Insurance, and take-home pay (England and Scotland)
• Check if Making Tax Digital (MTD) applies to you and when it starts
• See all your tax deadlines with countdown timers
• Work out your payments on account and how much to save monthly

• Find out if an expense is tax-deductible under HMRC rules
• Calculate capital allowances on business equipment and vehicles
• Scan receipts and categorise them for your tax return

All calculations use official HMRC rates for 2024-25 through 2026-27. No sign-up required, no data stored, MTD compliance completely free from HMRC-recognised software.

payload.name: Nsure Insurance Quotes
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get home insurance quotes from multiple insurers by filling in a single form. The app provides pricing, coverage details, and policy differences based on data from multiple insurers. Compare results side by side and select an option to continue your purchase through Nsure’s website.

payload.name: RateAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get real-time financing rates from 4,200 credit unions across all 50 states—covering mortgages, auto loans, HELOCs, personal loans, and credit cards. RateAPI delivers personalized recommendations based on your location, loan amount, and credit profile, with interactive comparisons and rate monitoring. Unlike estimate-based calculators, every rate comes from actual credit union data, helping you find competitive offers that traditional rate sites often miss.

payload.name: Chargebee (EU Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.

payload.name: OakbrookOne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OakbrookOne in ChatGPT helps you explore how turning multiple debts into one monthly payment could work for you - through a simple conversation. 

Share details about the debts you’re managing and see illustrative repayment scenarios. You can understand how combining balances into one structured plan might affect your monthly payment and overall repayment timeline. 

If you choose to proceed, you can continue your application securely on Oakbrook’s website. OakbrookOne will arrange repayment directly with your existing creditors if your application is approved. 

OakbrookOne provides general information and example calculations only. Eligibility, loan terms and creditor repayment are subject to Oakbrook’s standard lending assessment.

payload.name: Clear Energy Facts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clear Energy Facts gives you an up-to-date list of the best true fixed-rate electricity plans, along with the top free-nights and free-weekends plans on the market. Instead of wading through confusing offers and hidden fees, you get straightforward plan data you can trust. When paired with your Smart Meter Texas (SMT) usage data, it helps match your actual consumption patterns to the plan that will genuinely cost you the least — whether that's a steady fixed rate or a plan built around free nights and weekends.

payload.name: Superfunds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Superfunds is a live, comprehensive map of the Israeli mutual fund market. Ask in plain language — Hebrew or English — to find and filter funds by manager, theme, or strategy; compare fees, performance, and risk; browse curated themes and recently launched funds; view manager profiles with market share; and search market research and central-bank context. Informational only — not investment advice.

payload.name: D&B Risk Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Execute risk workflows powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com.

Dun & Bradstreet empowers teams to execute risk workflows such as KYC/KYB, entity resolution, screening, alert triage, and more using relationship-aware business context from the D&B Commercial Graph™. Verified risk data, anchored in the global standard D-U-N-S® Number business identifier, and policy-driven logic provide the foundation for consistent decisioning across systems of record and scalable risk operations in regulated environments.

You can use D&B Risk Analytics to:

Verify and onboard suppliers:
"Can you verify and cross-check the data from my vendor outreach form for <Company Name> for accuracy?"
Initiate third-party screening:
"Load this <Company Name> and initiate screening"
Assess overall risk:
"What is the overall risk rating for <Company Name>, and what are the key drivers behind it?"
Trace beneficial ownership:
"Who ultimately owns and controls <Company Name>, and are any owners or directors located in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions?"
Generate KYB decision reports:
"Give me a full KYB decision report for <Company Name> — should we approve, refer, or decline?"

Note: Requires D&B Risk Analytics license.

payload.name: MyTruv: AI Money Autopilot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your whole financial life, answered in ChatGPT.

Connect your accounts once, then just ask: "Where did my money go this month?", "How much lands on payday?", "What's hurting my credit score?" MyTruv answers from your real data across checking, savings, credit cards, loans, investments, and payroll.

What you can ask about
• Spending: balances, transactions, and a breakdown by category or merchant
• Bills and subscriptions: recurring charges and recurring income
• Income: gross vs. net pay, taxes, benefits, retirement contributions, and pay history
• Net worth: assets and debts over time, with credit limits, APR, and loan terms
• Credit: your score, what's moving it, utilization, and 24 months of payment history

Keep your data tidy
Ask MyTruv to fix a category, rename a merchant, hide a transaction, or set a rule for a merchant going forward. It confirms before changing many transactions at once.

Private and secure
MyTruv can never move your money. 256-bit AES encryption, SOC 2 Type II certified. No ads. Requires MyTruv Pro. Powered by Truv, trusted by 8M+ consumers.

payload.name: Finmagine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Indian & US stock screeners, financial ratios, AI-generated company research (quarterly summaries, concall tone/credibility decoding), market breadth, momentum ranking, and multi-agent Investment Committee analysis — the MCP server for Indian and US stock market intelligence.

payload.name: Nella Finance AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nella Finance AI is a read-only financial intelligence assistant for businesses and their accountants. Connect supported accounting platforms and ask questions about cash, performance, KPIs, unusual movements, management information and estimated tax indicators where supported, directly from ChatGPT.

Nella provides clear summaries based on the latest available accounting data and identifies when professional accounting judgement may be required. It does not make payments, post transactions or change accounting records. Tax projections and financial insights are estimates and should not be treated as regulated financial, investment or tax advice.

payload.name: REIzer Deal Analysis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
REIzer underwrites a real-estate deal the way an investor would. Give it a price and a few numbers and it returns a 0–100 score, the metrics that matter for that strategy, stress scenarios showing what breaks the deal, every assumption it filled in for you, and a shareable report link.

It covers long-term rental, short-term rental, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, multifamily and new construction. It can compare all six against the same property to find its best use, and solve backwards for the highest price you could pay and still hit your return targets.

Results are software estimates, not financial advice.

payload.name: MT Newswires
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MT Newswires brings real-time global financial news directly into ChatGPT — providing original, unbiased and comprehensive multi-asset class coverage of capital markets and economies in over 180 topics.

Powered by a global newsroom trusted by the largest banks, brokerages, professional trading, wealth management and research applications globally, every story is built for AI — so you get answers grounded in live market intelligence, not stale data.

What you can do:
• Get the latest news on any ticker and analyze price impact
• Monitor energy sector developments across global equities 
• Track macro events and global central bank signals in real time
• Screen for earnings, M&A, and market-moving headlines

Example prompts:
→ "What is the latest news for NVIDIA and has it influenced the stock's price?"
→ "Summarize the major analyst rating change developments from the past hour."
→ "What macro events are driving markets today?"

payload.name: Energy Ogre
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Energy Ogre helps Texas residents understand what they may be able to save on electricity. Check availability in your ZIP, enter a few details about your home and recent bill, and receive a personalized savings estimate with projected costs and a 12-month breakdown—all within ChatGPT.

payload.name: Seguro Match
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details. To skip the form, users can drag and drop their current policy document into the widget — it is processed server-side only (extracted text used solely to pre-fill the quote, never sent to the model). Final checkout happens on seguromatch.com; nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT.

Every signal is resolved against realized price in an append-only ledger. All 22 tools are read-only — no order routing, no path to capital. Engines without enough resolved outcomes report 'calibrating' — never an invented number. Observation, not financial advice.

payload.name: Mansa African Markets

payload.name: Manulife®
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seamlessly go from quote discovery to purchase. Answer a few questions about your trip to receive a personalized CoverMe® Travel Insurance quote, then continue to CoverMe.com, where your information carries over to help make purchasing coverage quick and easy.  
Before You Get Your Quote
To generate your travel insurance quote, we'll ask for information such as your date of birth, province of residence, travel destination, travel dates, and trip cost. Manulife uses the information received through this plugin to generate your quote, assess eligibility, and support the travel insurance quote and purchase process. Please provide only the information requested, and do not share additional information unless specifically requested as part of the quote process.
This plugin is available through ChatGPT, which is provided by OpenAI and is subject to OpenAI's terms, privacy practices, account settings, and data-handling practices.
This tool is intended only to help you request a travel insurance quote. It cannot be used to submit or manage a claim, request emergency or travel assistance, or send urgent or time-sensitive communications to Manulife. It supports single-trip coverage for one traveller. If you have pre-existing medical conditions, are looking for multi-trip or group coverage, or are not a Canadian citizen or resident, this tool may not be suitable for your needs. Do not use this tool to provide detailed medical information, health histories, treatment information, or other sensitive personal information. If you provide information about other individuals, please make sure you have their permission to do so.  
This experience helps you obtain a travel insurance quote and does not provide professional insurance advice. 
The quote provided is for informational purposes only and is not an insurance contract or guarantee of coverage.
For more information about how your information is collected, used, and protected, please review our Canadian Privacy Policy and Legal Information & Disclosures.

payload.name: TickerLayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TickerLayer brings real-time and historical global market data directly into ChatGPT. Access stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, commodities and government bond yields across markets worldwide.

Stocks & ETFs: Get live market snapshots, bid/ask quotes, latest trades, previous closes and historical OHLCV data for US and international equities and ETFs.

Forex & crypto: Check real-time currency pairs and cryptocurrency prices, compare markets and retrieve historical price data across custom date ranges.

Indices & commodities: Follow major global stock indices, gold, oil and other supported commodities with current market data and historical aggregates.

Government bonds: Check the latest US and major European government bond yields across supported maturities, including US Treasury yields.

Market hours: See whether markets are open, closed, in pre-market or post-market, and check trading sessions, holidays and early closures across supported regions.

Ask natural-language questions such as “How is Nvidia trading today?”, “Compare Bitcoin and gold over the last year”, “What is USD/TRY now?” or “What is the latest US 10-year Treasury yield?” and get answers backed by TickerLayer market data.

Built for investors, analysts, traders, developers and anyone who needs real-time or historical multi-asset financial market data inside ChatGPT.

payload.name: Shinhan Securities Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Shinhan Securities Vietnam account to review portfolio holdings, explore market trends in Vietnam, and get instant answers to investment-related questions directly in ChatGPT.

It supports forex, metals, crypto, stocks, indices, futures, and CFDs. TradingNX is educational risk-management software only and does not provide buy, sell, hold, investment, or financial advice.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace helps pet owners find and compare pet insurance plans from leading top providers — all in one conversation.
Tell the app about your pet and get live quotes from multiple providers side by side. Compare monthly premiums, deductibles, annual limits, and coverage details. When you're ready, click through directly to your chosen carrier's website to complete enrolment.

Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace is powered by Fletch, an insurance technology platform. All quotes are non-binding estimates. Final pricing and coverage are determined by the individual carriers. Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace is not an insurance carrier nor acting as a licensed agency in this capacity — it is a comparison and discovery tool that connects you with licensed insurers. 
Supported pets: Dogs and Cats.Available for US residents only.

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stable.com is a read-only information and order-tracking companion for the Stable platform. It looks up supported networks and assets, estimates indicative rates and fees, tracks the status of swaps a user has already started, and shows wallet balances and token allowances. The app does not execute trades, move or hold funds, or provide investment advice; any action is completed by the user on the Stable platform at stable.com.

With Trata MCP, your assistant will have the tools to reason across hundreds of calls in our library. It goes beyond simple searches to help breakdown bull and bear cases, compare analyst sentiment across time, and deep dive into stock analysis. We compress what would take hours of analyst research into a single question.

payload.name: Datarails FinanceOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Datarails FinanceOS brings structure and intelligence to your financial data. It provides a managed, organized database that keeps your numbers clean and reliable. Every change is fully traced with a built-in audit trail, so you always know who changed what and when. A robust permission mechanism ensures each user sees only the data they're authorized to access. And with built-in financial logic, the app understands your business context out of the box - no manual setup required.

payload.name: SkyWatch.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

Key Features: - Real time renters insurance quotes are displayed in a structured quote summary. - Flexible coverage options include daily, weekly, monthly, or annual policies. - A transparent breakdown of liability limits and coverages is provided.

When ready to proceed, users are securely redirected to SkyWatch’s web portal to complete purchase, with previously entered information preserved.

How Does It Work?
Pilots answer a short series of aviation specific questions about their experience and coverage needs. The app generates a personalized quote and displays a detailed summary directly within ChatGPT. Users can adjust duration and review updated pricing instantly before being securely redirected to SkyWatch’s official web portal to complete policy issuance.

Who Is This For?
Student and licensed pilots who rent or borrow non owned aircraft.
Pilots who need flexible, short term coverage before a lesson, checkout, or rental flight.

Important Information:
 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.

payload.name: MutuiOnline.it
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With this app, you can quickly and easily search and compare the mortgage offers available on MutuiOnline.it. The app allows you to find the solutions that best suit your needs by comparing top offers from dozens of banks and lenders in Italy. If you’d like to learn more, you can be redirected to MutuiOnline.it, where you can request further information and get in touch with the lender of your choice. The service is free of charge and without obligation.

payload.name: PocketSmith Complete Access
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

This connector lets ChatGPT have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.

Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Go beyond "what did I spend?": uncover unusual merchant and timing patterns, see what your spending reveals about your priorities and turn years of financial data into answers, stories and decisions that feel relevant to your life.

Get answers to questions like: "why does my cash flow dip next month?", "what changed our net worth most this year?" and "what does our spending suggest we valued, and which choices bought us the most joy, ease or security?"

Keep your budget in check: review budget performance, analyze spending trends across periods, find recurring expenses, plus access monthly reviews and financial health snapshots.

Plan ahead: use PocketSmith's forecasting engine to predict future cashflow and net worth, and manage the budget events that map out your future.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.

Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.

ChatGPT connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.

payload.name: Vestd
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Vestd connector gives your AI direct access to your company's equity management data - shareholders, share classes, option grants (EMI, ESOP, CSOP, unapproved, growth shares), stock transfers, valuations, dividends, directors, and statutory filings (SH01s, confirmation statements, resolutions).

Instead of navigating the Vestd platform, ask your AI to investigate an issuance, trace a grant's acceptance and signing status, check share authorisation headroom across companies, review governance settings, or summarise ownership structure and dilution - all grounded in your live Vestd data.

Built for founders, finance teams, and company secretaries who manage equity on Vestd and want faster, conversational access to the records behind it.

payload.name: Steadily
